title: Pi-Tree Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for the 'piTree' field in a pi-tree plugin's package.json. Declares plugin capabilities discovered by the server at startup.

sourceType.description: Source type registration — describes a new kind of source this plugin provides.

key.description: Unique source type key (e.g. "book", "news", "paper"). Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

label.description: Human-readable label (e.g. "Book", "News Feed"). Defaults to key.

icon.description: Lucide icon name in kebab-case (e.g. "book-open", "newspaper"). Defaults to "puzzle".

defaultMode.description: Default mode when auto-creating the first session. Defaults to "reading".

autoStartMode.description: If set, skip the welcome screen and auto-create a session with this mode.

hasProcessing.description: Whether this source type supports processing (e.g. EPUB → Markdown conversion). Defaults to false.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the library search bar.

chatPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the chat input.

mentionKeyword.description: Keyword matched in @mentions (e.g. "News", "Paper"). If omitted, source titles are fuzzy-matched.

fixedSourceId.description: Fixed source ID for singleton source types (e.g. "news"). The router will always route mentions to this source.

sessionStrategy.description: Session reuse strategy. "reuse-same-mode" (default) reuses existing sessions of the same mode. "time-based" creates new sessions based on staleness.

askAfterHours.description: For time-based strategy: hours after which to suggest asking the user about continuing. Default: 4.

staleAfterHours.description: For time-based strategy: hours after which the session is considered stale. Default: 12.

routingContextFile.description: Relative path from $DATA_PATH to a JSON config file that provides routing context (e.g. "sources/news/feeds.json").

routingContextLabel.description: Human-readable label describing the routing context (e.g. "Available news feeds and topic tags").

addSource.description: Configuration for the "Add Source" modal tab. If absent, this source type won't appear in the add-source modal.

subtitle.description: Subtitle shown below the tab header in the Add Source modal.

hasFileUpload.description: Whether this tab supports file upload.

fields.description: Form fields to render in the add-source form.

key.description: Field key — maps to the source property or metadata key.

label.description: Human-readable label shown above the input.

metadataKey.description: If set, value goes into metadata[metadataKey] instead of top-level source property.

cardSubtitle.description: Template for the library card subtitle. Supports {field} placeholders resolved from source properties (e.g. "{author}, {year}").

value.description: If set, check equality (source[field] === value). If omitted, check truthiness.

label.description: Badge label text shown on the library card.

systemContext.description: Custom system context prompt template. Each element is one line. Supports {sourceId}, {userId}, {videoId} placeholders.

tagPromptTemplate.description: Prompt template for #tag mentions. {tags} is replaced with the tag list.

qualifierPromptTemplate.description: Prompt template for :qualifier mentions. {qualifier} is replaced with the value.

routes.description: Path to the routes module (relative to package.json), e.g. "./routes.ts".

routePrefix.description: URL prefix for mounting routes, e.g. "/api/news". Defaults to /api/{pluginName}.

contentPanel.description: Path to the content panel React component (relative to package.json).
